headline: Mooring Shifts as Contested Fronts Stir
war_summary: Since the last edition, Mooring County’s balance has edged from six Warden and five Colonial bases to five and six, with one neutral. Ten events were logged in the latest two hours and 55 over the day, alongside rising casualty and enlistment rates. Weathered Expanse has also altered: its Warden count fell from three to two, while neutral bases rose from two to three; four events occurred in two hours and 35 in 24. Linn Mercy’s tally of ten Colonial bases and one neutral is unchanged. It has seen four events in six hours, but none in the latest two. Callum’s Cape remains split four to three, though its 35 events over the day have paused in the latest six hours. Marban Hollow still stands three Colonial, three Warden and two neutral after 13 events in 24 hours, with none in six. Stlican Shelf logged six events over the day, also without recent activity. The contest remains undecided; 34 victory towns are required.
